text:
lisa: Heads up 0 partner BlueBox Edge reported a ~ $9.7k negative adjustment in last month's marketplace billing. they think late per-minute batches were squashed by our hourly merge and rounding logic. tagging partners/ops.

tom: can we pull the raw minute events for the impacted customer range? sounds like ordering + merge semantics bug.

ravi: i grabbed sample payloads. we got mixed increments + occasional full snapshots from their connector. snapshots sometimes arrive out of order (arrive after later increments). our hourly merge currently applies incrementals in arrival order which can flip the net usage.

emily: question: do snapshots contain a stable sequence id? if so we can prefer the latest snapshot atomically.

nav: BlueBox Edge added header X-Snapshot-Seq in v3 of their SDK but older installs don't. lots of partners do mixed-mode to save bandwidth.

lisa: impact: downstream ledger shows negative credits for customers; partners dispute potential refunds. we need short-term stopgap + long-term fix.

ravi: mitigation idea (short-term): if a snapshot arrives with timestamp older than current hour state by >1 hour, mark as "stale-snapshot" and hold for manual review. if snapshot_seq present and greater than applied_seq, allow backfill.

tom: long-term: add tombstone records per (partner, hour, snapshot_seq) so rollup treats snapshot as canonical and ignores incrementals with older seq. also add an idempotent backfill job to recompute hour windows from snapshot state.

emily: metrics to check before we run backfills: how many hours affected, total customer count, and estimated ledger delta. i can run a quick aggregator across last 120 days.

recon-bot: created ticket PRJ-6800: "bluebox-edge-hourly-merge-replay" assigned to @ravi. (https://redwood.atlassian.com/PRJ-6800) :robot_face:

ravi: playbook sketch:
- dry-run backfill to compute ledger deltas per invoice cycle and produce CSV for partners
- partners sign-off on credits where customers affected > 0
- apply adjustments via ledger-service compensating API (POST /ledger/adjustments) which creates reversing entries not destructive edits
- emit audit + notify billing-run and legal teams

nav: for gating we should add an ingestion monitor: if ratio of out-of-order snapshots > 0.3% for any partner in 24h, create pager and restrict auto-apply.

tom: also add unit tests around tombstone precedence and rollup merge ordering. ravi, i'll pair on that.

emily: estimated backfill size from sampling: ~2.1k hourly windows impacted, approx 0.12 cluster-hours on the batch runner. ledger delta estimate ~ $9.1k (close to reported).

ravi: owners + ETAs:
- ravi: open PR for tombstone ingestion + rollup merge logic + dry-run job (ETA 3 days)
- tom: tests + ledger-service contract validation (ETA 4 days)
- emily: run full 120d sample + produce partner CSV (ETA 1 day)
- lisa: draft partner comms and coordinate legal review (ETA 1 day)

lisa: partner ask: can BlueBox Edge push SDK update to include X-Snapshot-Seq for older customers? partnerships to request feature flag.

av: if partner agrees we can run an extended reconciliation for past 6 months once we have snapshot_seq coverage. otherwise we'll rely on tombstones + manual approvals.

emily: i'll post the CSV + summary to the partner channel when ready.

lisa: scheduling a sync with BlueBox Edge tomorrow 9am PT to go over findings and proposed playbook. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
